name: HFS CRM — Receive WA File (v2 STAGING)

nodes.name: Evolution API Webhook
nodes.notes: STAGING ONLY. Temporary parallel pipeline used to validate the metadata-only inbound path before it reaches main. The live workflow (hfs-receive-wa-file) fans out to this path, so one real WhatsApp message exercises both pipelines and production behaviour is unchanged. Delete this workflow after cutover.

nodes.name: Filter: Media Only
nodes.notes: Only forward messages that contain a downloadable file. Text/reaction/status events are dropped.

nodes.name: Filter: Groups Only
nodes.notes: Only process messages from group chats (remoteJid ends with @g.us). Individual DMs are ignored.

nodes.name: Extract Media Metadata
nodes.notes: Pulls groupId / sender / messageId / fileName / mimeType / size / mediaUrl out of the Evolution payload. Throws with a clear message if mediaUrl is absent, which is the signal that S3_ENABLED is off or MinIO is unreachable.

nodes.name: POST to CRM Webhook
nodes.notes: Points at the hfs-crm-staging Railway service (tracks branch claude/happy-ramanujan-6xgc5d). URL is pinned rather than $env because CRM_BACKEND_URL points at production. Secret still comes from $env.WEBHOOK_SECRET. Test from a WhatsApp group with NO wa_group_id mapping so rows land in unmatched_inbox and never touch a real engagement's inbox.

parameters.errorMessage: CRM webhook returned an error — check execution log

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes: The CRM webhook is idempotent (dedup by messageId), so a retry is safe. It now returns real 4xx/5xx responses instead of always 200, so failures surface as failed executions here rather than vanishing into the backend log.

notes: TEMPORARY staging workflow — delete after the change is merged and the live workflow is cut over.
Staging shares the production Postgres, so ALWAYS test from a group with no wa_group_id mapping: those rows go to unmatched_inbox and are trivially deleted.
Requires the same Evolution setup as the live workflow: S3_ENABLED=true, and 'Webhook Base64' OFF.
Pass criteria before merging: a 200MB file lands in MinIO with the correct size recorded, a bad mediaUrl returns a non-2xx (failed execution here), and the legacy fileBase64 body still works.
